amblyopia-stereopsis.name: Pediatric Amblyopia (Stereopsis) Screener
amblyopia-stereopsis.intro: Enter stereopsis test results to evaluate stereoacuity and pediatric amblyopia risk; normal stereoacuity is 60 arc-seconds or better.

amsler-grid-test.name: Amsler Grid Test (Macular Self-Monitoring)
amsler-grid-test.intro: Standard Amsler grid for home macular monitoring with per-eye steps, region marking, snapshot comparison and export.

analysis-12.name: Visual Field Defect (MD/PSD) Analyzer
analysis-12.intro: Analyze visual field defects from MD (mean deviation) and PSD (pattern standard deviation) values to grade glaucomatous damage, a clinical reference aid.

astigmatism-chart.name: Astigmatism Fan Chart Self-Test
astigmatism-chart.intro: Equidistant fan chart to screen astigmatism risk; mark the blurred sectors to estimate axis and relative severity in real time.

axial-length.name: Ocular A-Scan Axial Length Calculator
axial-length.intro: Sum segmental sound-speed lengths into total axial length and apply the IOL correction (about 2.5 D per 1 mm error) to aid pre-cataract biometry.

calc-1.name: Intraocular Pressure (CCT) Correction
calc-1.intro: Estimate corrected intraocular pressure from measured IOP and central corneal thickness (CCT) to aid glaucoma risk assessment.

calc-length-1.name: IOL Power Calculation (A-Scan Biometry)
calc-length-1.intro: Enter axial length, corneal curvature, anterior chamber depth and lens thickness, then choose an IOL formula to estimate the emmetropic target IOL power.

cd-ratio.name: Optic Disc Cup-to-Disc (C/D) Ratio Evaluator
cd-ratio.intro: Enter vertical cup-to-disc ratios of both eyes to assess glaucomatous optic neuropathy, asymmetry and the ISNT rule.

convert-42.name: Visual Acuity (Snellen / logMAR) Converter
convert-42.intro: Convert between Snellen acuity and logMAR and show the decimal acuity equivalent for chart cross-reference; client-side conversion for interpretation only.

corneal-curvature.name: Corneal Curvature (K1/K2) and Astigmatism Calculator
corneal-curvature.intro: Derive curvature radius from r=(n-1)/K and compute corneal astigmatism magnitude, axis and power from K1 and K2 for refraction and contact lens fitting.

corneal-endothelium.name: Corneal Endothelium (Density & Morphology) Counter
corneal-endothelium.intro: From specular microscopy cell counts, compute endothelial cell density (CD), coefficient of variation (CV) and hexagonality (6A) to grade corneal endothelial function.

detector-6.name: Pediatric Amblyopia Stereopsis Detector
detector-6.intro: Enter age and measured stereoacuity to assess children's stereo vision development and amblyopia risk.

eye-chart-toolkit.name: Professional Eye Chart Toolkit
eye-chart-toolkit.intro: Seven chart types (Snellen, logMAR, Jaeger, pediatric symbols, Tumbling E, Landolt C and astigmatism dial) with screen PPI calibration and test distance control.

fluorescein-staining.name: Ocular Surface (Fluorescein Staining) Scorer
fluorescein-staining.intro: NEI (US National Eye Institute) zonal scoring: cornea in 5 zones and nasal/temporal conjunctiva in 3 zones each, 0-3 points per zone, scored separately.

iol-power.name: IOL Power (SRK-T) Calculator
iol-power.intro: Enter axial length, keratometry and the IOL A-constant to compute IOL power with an optional target refraction reserve.

iop-correction.name: Goldmann / NCT Intraocular Pressure Corrector
iop-correction.intro: Enter measured IOP and central corneal thickness to estimate true IOP and assess how corneal thickness biases the reading.

ishihara-test.name: Color Vision (Ishihara) Plate Test
ishihara-test.intro: Read the number in each pseudo-isochromatic plate; normal color vision reads them all while red-green deficiency misreads or cannot read them. Screening tool, not diagnostic.

meibomian-grading.name: Meibomian Gland (Infrared Meibography) Grader
meibomian-grading.intro: From infrared meibography, grade gland dropout, dilation and secretion quality of the upper and lower lids to score MGD severity.

oct-rnfl.name: OCT RNFL Thickness Glaucoma Evaluator
oct-rnfl.intro: Enter global and quadrant RNFL thickness (um) and age, compare with a normative database and check the ISNT rule.

osdi-scale.name: Dry Eye OSDI Self-Assessment Scale
osdi-scale.intro: Standard 12-item OSDI questionnaire that computes total and subscale scores with severity grading for dry eye symptom assessment.

pterygium-measurement.name: Pterygium (Head & Body) Measurement
pterygium-measurement.intro: Enter head encroachment, body width and length (mm) to compute the corneal encroachment ratio and grade the pterygium.

pupil-reflex.name: Pupillary Light Reflex Grader
pupil-reflex.intro: Grade the direct light reflex and RAPD to help localize afferent optic nerve or efferent oculomotor deficits; a neuro-ophthalmology exam aid.

rater-7.name: Ocular Surface (Fluorescein) Staining Score
rater-7.intro: van Bijsterveld ocular surface fluorescein staining score across 3 zones (total 0-9; higher means more severe damage).

rater-8.name: Visual Fatigue (VAS) Questionnaire
rater-8.intro: Visual analogue scale (VAS) fatigue score: 8 symptoms rated 0-10 each, total 0-80.

refraction-error.name: Refractive Error Cross-Cylinder Calculator
refraction-error.intro: Convert plus/minus cylinders, compute the spherical equivalent and power vector decomposition, and combine two cylinders (over-refraction / stacking).

self-assess-2.name: Dry Eye OSDI Index (Self-Assessment)
self-assess-2.intro: Twelve-item OSDI questionnaire computing the 0-100 OSDI index with severity grading for daily dry eye self-monitoring.

strabismus-angle.name: Strabismus Angle (Prism / Synoptophore) Calculator
strabismus-angle.intro: Convert prism diopters (PD) to degrees, run Krimsky/Hirschberg estimation and stack multiple prisms.

tear-breakup-time.name: Tear Break-Up Time (BUT) Evaluator
tear-breakup-time.intro: Enter tear break-up time (BUT, seconds) to grade tear film stability per the Asia Dry Eye consensus and the Chinese dry eye guideline.

vision-screening-21.name: 21-Item Adaptive Vision Screening (Per-Eye Power Estimate)
vision-screening-21.intro: Independent adaptive Q&A for the left and right eye estimates approximate myopic spherical equivalent and astigmatism axis from symptom load; medical disclaimer included.

visual-acuity-converter.name: Visual Acuity Converter (Snellen / logMAR / ETDRS)
visual-acuity-converter.intro: Convert across Snellen (20/6/5 m), decimal, logMAR, ETDRS letter count, Chinese standard logarithmic (5-point) acuity and special records such as light perception.

visual-fatigue-vas.name: Visual Fatigue (VAS) Scale Questionnaire
visual-fatigue-vas.intro: VAS visual analogue scale (0-10) to quantify fatigue plus a 12-item visual fatigue symptom questionnaire for a combined assessment.

visual-field-analysis.name: Humphrey Visual Field (MD/PSD) Interpreter
visual-field-analysis.intro: Enter standard white-on-white (Humphrey 24-2/30-2) indices to analyze glaucomatous field loss; MD/PSD may be entered with the conventional negative or positive sign.
